LETTER OF APPOINTMENT

Date: 3 March 2026
To: Priya Sharma
Bengaluru, Karnataka

Dear Priya Sharma,

Nimbus Softech Private Limited (the "Company") is pleased to offer you the position of Associate Software Engineer at our Bengaluru development centre, on the terms set out below.

1. Compensation
Your annual Cost to Company (CTC) will be Rs. 9,60,000 (Rupees Nine Lakh Sixty Thousand only), which includes fixed pay, a variable performance component of 15%, employer contribution to Provident Fund, gratuity and group medical insurance premium. The variable component will be paid at the sole discretion of the management based on company and individual performance. A detailed salary breakup is provided in Annexure A.

2. Date of Joining and Joining Formalities
Your date of joining will be 1 April 2026. At the time of joining you shall submit and deposit your original degree certificates and mark sheets with the HR department, which will be retained by the Company for the duration of the service bond. You agree to serve the Company for a minimum period of two (2) years from the date of joining. If you leave the services of the Company before completing this period, you shall pay the Company liquidated damages of Rs. 2,00,000 towards training costs incurred on you.

3. Probation
You will be on probation for a period of six (6) months from the date of joining. The probation period may be extended at the discretion of the management for such further period as it may deem fit. During probation, either party may terminate employment by giving fifteen (15) days notice.

4. Notice Period
After confirmation, you will be required to give ninety (90) days written notice of resignation. The Company may, at its sole discretion, decline any request to buy out or shorten the notice period. The Company may terminate your employment immediately without notice or salary in lieu.

5. Place of Posting and Transfer
Your initial place of posting is Bengaluru. However, you may be transferred or deputed to any location, department, client site or group company in India or abroad at the sole discretion of the management, and such transfer shall not entitle you to any additional allowance.

6. Intellectual Property
All inventions, software, ideas and works created by you during the period of your employment, whether or not during working hours and whether or not using Company resources, shall be the exclusive property of the Company.

7. Restrictive Covenants
For a period of twelve (12) months after you leave the Company for any reason, you shall not join or work for any client or competitor of the Company anywhere in India, and you shall not solicit any employee of the Company.

8. Company Policies
You will be governed by the rules, policies and code of conduct of the Company as amended from time to time, which shall form part of your terms of employment. Your resignation will require sixty (60) days notice as per the HR policy.

9. Background Verification
This offer is subject to satisfactory background verification. The Company reserves the right to withdraw this offer at any time without assigning any reason, even after you have joined.

10. Governing Law
This letter shall be governed by the laws of India and the courts at Bengaluru shall have exclusive jurisdiction. Any dispute shall be referred to arbitration by a sole arbitrator appointed by the Company.

Please sign and return a copy of this letter as a token of your acceptance.

For Nimbus Softech Private Limited
Rahul Mehta, Head - Talent Acquisition
careers@nimbussoftech.example
